name: Bluefield State University
tuition_note: Public school. In-state (resident) full-time tuition & fees: $4,824/semester x 2 = $9,648/year (Fall 2026/Spring 2027, 12+ credit hours) from bluefieldstate.edu/tuition-and-fees. Housing room only: MEC/Cottage standard Double Room $6,400/academic year (2026-2027) from bluefieldstate.edu/housing; board (meal plan) is separate and not included.
